arguments.body:
Lumenrail took the Scale plan out of beta on 2026-10-27.

- Price: $349/month billed annually ($419 billed monthly)
- Included events: 50M events per month (extra events $6 per million)
- Also: 13-month retention, SAML SSO

The 2025 beta was $299/month with 25M events; beta customers keep that price until renewal.

Source: https://lumenrail.io/blog/scale-plan-generally-available
arguments.title: Lumenrail Scale plan is generally available
